items.title: The natural comparison map on Tor one for a quotient by an extended ideal is surjective
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a ring map R to R', an ideal I with extension I', and an R-module M, the natural comparison map from Tor_1 over R of the quotient by I' to Tor_1 over R' of the base change is surjective (statement lines 24097-24104). The proof does not compute either Tor group with an explicit resolution over the target ring: it notes that the base change of a free resolution need not remain exact, completes it by an extra free module, identifies the two complexes computing the Tor groups modulo the extended ideal, and exhibits a vertical map of complexes that is visibly surjective on cohomology (proof lines 24106-24135, with the diagram drawn in Xy-pic). Supplying the extra free module so that the comparison becomes a map of complexes is the content, and the author writes the diagram out. H2.
